classification.difficultyReason: Recognise shading covering either circle, including the overlap, as a union.

content.prompt: Use set notation to describe the shaded sets.

spec.description: Both circles and their overlap are uniformly shaded; exterior white. Labels A left and B right with short leaders.
spec.mathematics: Two overlapping sets with both interiors selected.
spec.answerVisibility: Supplied region shading only; no symbolic answer.

answer.worked: The shading includes every point in either circle, including their overlap. The set is $A\cup B$.
